paragraphs: In Eruvin 28b: Rabbah bar Tuviah bar Yitzchak. Hyman reports that in Dikdukei Soferim the words “bar Tuviah” are absent, leaving only Rabbah bar Yitzchak.[^1]

notes.text: The whole selected Davidson Eruvin 28b paragraph has Rabbah bar Tuviah bar Yitzchak reporting in Rav’s name. This supports the literal chain in the supplied notice. Dikdukei Soferim itself was not freshly collated here: the omission of “bar Tuviah” and resulting shorter chain remain Hyman’s collation report, not a new father-identity decision.
